baseline_prompt_en: Create a refined documentary photograph of an adult fictional woman whose general appearance follows the attached portrait: long center-parted dark wavy hair, brown eyes, a softly oval facial outline, natural brows, and attentive calm. In a quiet nocturnal conservation salon above a storm-flooded city, she serves as the sole private materials advisor to one adult client holding a water-damaged heirloom map case. She responds directly to the damaged edge by presenting exactly three relevant leather-and-lining options on a compact viewing tray. Her gloved hands fit the chosen protective insert around the same rolled map and test the case closure while the client points to the original water mark. A blank restoration-and-aftercare folder lies open beside the selected swatch, establishing the next repair step without personal information. Compose the advisor, client, three options, fitting action, and follow-up record in one intimate medium-wide frame, with dark stone, warm wood, restrained brass, storm reflections, and deliberate quiet pacing.
